summary: Verified the two targeted fixes: (1) Backend export endpoints /api/export/patients and /api/export/visits now return ALL records for the current doctor with response shape {data,count,total} and no skip/limit params or caps; verified with 12 patients & 8 visits. Data isolation still holds (doctor A only sees own records). (2) Frontend BirthdatePicker on NewPatientPage and PatientProfilePage edit-mode correctly retains a past date chosen via the Year/Month dropdowns + day grid — no revert to today's date. End-to-end patient create with birthdate 1985-03-20 succeeded and shows 'March 20, 1985' on the profile; edit-mode change to June 15, 1975 was retained and persisted after Save.
critical_code_review_comments: BirthdatePicker uses classNames={{caption_label:'hidden'}} — good. captionLayout='dropdown-buttons' fromYear=1900, toYear=currentYear, disabled after today — all correct per requirement.

server.py export endpoints correctly use to_list(length=None) and exclude _id — good. Consider adding streaming/pagination flag as future enhancement for very large datasets to avoid memory blowup, but current behavior matches product requirement.
test_credentials: Registered fresh trial + doctor accounts per run (dynamic emails).
seed_data_creation: 12 TEST_ patients + 8 visits (isolated per test doctor), plus 2 patients (TEST Patient DOB, TEST Edit Patient) via UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both changes validated in iteration_19. Backend export tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_export_unlimited.py (3/3 pass). Frontend BirthdatePicker exposes data-testids patient-birthdate-trigger and edit-patient-birthdate-trigger. rdp dropdowns are native <select name='years'> and <select name='months'> (month values 0-11).
